revision.scope:
One bounded simultaneous48-knot nominal pose/force/command-time optimization.
No physics, runtime, learning, or physical admission. Local NLP failure is not impossibility.
revision.construction: Simultaneous48nodes56..103 rootxy,independent monotone descent/orientation,12legangles and nullspace-footforces plus49segmenttimes. Preserve actual MODELED330feet/COM atnodes; original target/screens remain. No extra knee equality/bound. Frozen330remainingposes,332remainingcommands. Minimize full115-node commandpolyline time, hard .03margin/effort/nonnegativeforce/static-equilibrium/.15necessaryrate/13.5time and originaljointbounds. No actualfilter or dynamics. Full clippedmesh/finitepatch/CoP/floor/foot/tilt are FINAL rejection gates, not differentiated optimizer constraints; no admission if any fail.
revision.inputs: saved1s current-sensor development fixture, frozen staticmodel; never runtime injection
